# DS-Mate plugins for Claude Code

<!-- GENERATED by `pnpm --filter @ds-mate/connector-core run publish:contract`. Do not edit here. -->

The official Claude Code marketplace of DS-Mate (<https://www.ds-mate.com>).

```text
/plugin marketplace add DS-Mate/claude-code-plugins
/plugin install ds-mate@ds-mate
```

| Plugin | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [ds-mate](plugins/ds-mate) | Ask Claude Code about your DS-Mate dropshipping account: orders, stores, products, suppliers, unlinked variants, eBay buyer messages (on a plan with messaging), the dashboard summary and AliExpress product search. You choose what Claude may do when you sign in. |

- Support: support@ds-mate.com, <https://www.ds-mate.com/contact>
- Privacy: <https://www.ds-mate.com/privacy>
